decisions.reason: Its dedicated page and product-line scope indicate results close enough to aspirations, and organizational slack allows keeping it while uncertainty remains.
As a building block of the modular system, it likely meets aspirations and dropping it would disrupt the established offer.
Like Product D, it extends the core system and shows sufficient support to be retained under current aspirations.
Only a website mention without a dedicated page signals performance below aspiration, triggering problemistic search to reallocate resources to established business or new development.
